metadata.title: Cloud Third-Party Access

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing and constraining access to cloud environments by third parties, partners, vendors, and external services.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Third-party integrations, delegated access models, federated identities, APIs, service principals, and vendor-managed cloud access.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Establishes trust and governance boundaries for third-party access to cloud resources.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Third-party access relies on cloud-native identity and authorization mechanisms.

metadata.remarks: Cloud Third-Party Access defines the trust properties required to safely grant and govern access to cloud environments by external entities. This pattern explicitly addresses the elevated risk introduced by vendors, partners, and integrations by ensuring access is constrained, attributable, time-bound, and continuously observable.

components.title: Third-Party Identity Governance
components.description: Governance of identities and credentials used by third parties within cloud environments.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid third-party or vendor cloud accounts.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong governance and lifecycle management of third-party cloud identities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Least privilege enforced for third-party roles.

components.title: Delegated Access Boundaries
components.description: Constraining the scope, privileges, and duration of third-party access.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted relationships through compromised vendors or integrations.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit scoping, boundary definition, and time limitation of delegated access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Enforcement of approved authorizations for third-party access.
Separation of duties between internal and external access.
Restricted changes to delegated trust configurations.

components.title: Third-Party Activity Observability
components.description: Visibility and attribution of actions taken by third parties in cloud environments.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Defense evasion through disabling or bypassing third-party activity logging.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Logging and monitoring of third-party actions for accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Review and analysis of third-party audit events.
Continuous monitoring of third-party access posture.
